title: remembers each seek as it is sent, and none it refuses (issue 660)
why: The scrub sends its seek without remembering it: the page a run wrote is given back the clock the page being left said, and a scrub made as the run ended is lost.

title: remembers each seek as it is sent, and none it refuses (issue 660)
why: The seek remembered as it is asked for, before the debounce: one still waiting when the page being left is read passes for one that page had taken, and the restore seeks over it.

title: is sought there even where the page being left said nothing
why: The restore composed without the seek made since the page being left was read: where that page refused to answer, the restore has no seek at all, and the new page stays where it starts.

title: keeps the count with the clock it was read with when a read fails
why: The count kept at every ask, answered or not: a page scrubbed directly and then too busy to answer is given back neither its own clock nor the seek that moved it.

title: gives a project opened again no seek from its last visit
why: The count started from nothing as the frame mounts: the first page of a project opened again is sent where it was scrubbed to on the last visit.

title: reads that seek again for the call, not as the list was composed
why: A scrub during the restore's own round trips overwritten by the seek it composed before.

title: is the one after the count the page being left was read at, else nothing
why: A seek made before the page being left was read given back: a scrub from minutes ago pulls a playing map back to it at every redraw.

title: takes the place of the clock the page being left said, and only then
why: The seek handed to the composition and dropped: the restore seeks the new page to the old page's clock.

title: is given back the clock the page being left said when nobody moved it since
why: The count never taken as the page being left is asked: a seek the old page took and has since played on from is given back over the clock it reports.
